title: Soft delete and history
objectives: Soft deletion separates active records from historical records. A partial uniqueness rule can permit reusing an archived label while preventing duplicates among active labels.
The partial unique index applies only to active labels, while the trigger records the archive transition in a separate table for review.
securityBoundary: Soft delete is not a substitute for retention policy, access revocation, legal erasure or a cryptographically protected audit trail. The example logs only the transition and is not a complete event-sourcing system.
